name: Riftbound
source:
Setting in a medieval fantasy world where rifts tear through reality, unleashing chaotic effects. 

The story follows a group of three idiots united by a common goal: uncovering the truth about the rifts and their impact on the world. Together, they navigate treacherous guild politics and perhaps flirt with a few shady characters along the way. As they progress, they’ll discover hidden strengths, unexpected friendships, and many reasons to reconsider their life choices. 

[From [url=https://rysuutekki.itch.io/riftbound]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以中世纪奇幻世界为背景，现实中出现裂痕，释放出混乱的效果。

故事讲述了三个白痴为了一个共同目标而团结在一起的故事：揭开裂痕的真相及其对世界的影响。他们一起应对危险的公会政治，并可能一路上与一些阴暗人物调情。随着他们的进步，他们会发现隐藏的优势、意想不到的友谊，以及许多重新考虑人生选择的理由。

[来自[url=https://rysuutekki.itch.io/riftbound]Itch.io[/url]]
